title: Collections Standard on Current-Month Charges in Payment Plan Arrears
content:
Which charges the arrears of an Apartment Home Lease payment plan take in follows the day of signing, counted in calendar days from the due date of the current month (the latest billing period carrying a base rent line):

- a resident who signs within the plan grace days leaves the current month's base rent line and recurring fee lines out of the plan arrears, because they are not yet past due;
- a resident who signs after the plan grace days but no more than 10 days after the due date leaves only the current month's recurring fee lines out;
- any later signature takes in the whole ledger balance.

**Plan grace days** are the longer of the floor plan's grace period (3 calendar days on every floor plan) and the minimum late days of the community's state: 5 in Washington, 7 in Colorado, 2 in Texas, none in any other state. What is left out comes off the ledger balance, and the plan arrears never fall below zero.

## Plan grace days by state

| State of the community | Minimum late days | Plan grace days (with a floor plan grace period of 3) |
|---|---|---|
| Washington | 5 | 5 |
| Colorado | 7 | 7 |
| Texas | 2 | 3 |
| California, Georgia, Arizona | none | 3 |

## Signing day and what is left out

| Days from the current month's due date to the day of signing | Left out of the plan arrears |
|---|---|
| no more than the plan grace days | the current month's base rent line and recurring fee lines |
| more than the plan grace days, no more than 10 | the current month's recurring fee lines only |
| more than 10 | nothing — the whole ledger balance |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, current month due 1 June)

| Community | Signed on | Days after the due date | Left out |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arizona | 4 June | 3 | base rent line and recurring fee lines |
| Arizona | 5 June | 4 | recurring fee lines only |
| Arizona | 11 June | 10 | recurring fee lines only |
| Arizona | 12 June | 11 | nothing |
| Colorado | 8 June | 7 | base rent line and recurring fee lines |
| Colorado | 9 June | 8 | recurring fee lines only |
